text:
alex: quick proposal from yesterday's after-action: add a hard closure gate for postmortems + lightweight periodic checkpoints so action items don't drift. thinking: 24h quick-check, 72h assignment verification, 1w status, and 30d recurrence audit.

tanya: yes please. we've had too many "assigned, then disappeared" cases. can the gate require a tracked remediation owner + ETA? also prefer short structured updates only.

lee: agree on structure. want to keep the template machine-friendly so we can auto-index fields. suggests fields: owner, status, next_step, blocker, related_incidents. no long paragraphs.

diego: curious about the rotation angle. can we make incident commander rotation weekly but pair the new IC with the previous IC for first shift (buddy handoff) so context isn't lost? buddy must ack the handoff in thread.

priya: automation ideas: oncall-bot posts a one-click checklist prompt in the thread at each checkpoint; owner can click reactions to mark steps done and that fires audit events. reduces typing.

oncall-bot: prototype behavior: will post a checklist message at 24h/72h/1w; reactions :white_check_mark: and :warning: will be captured to the audit log (mock).

alex: sample pasteable checkpoint card (please keep short):

```
Checkpoint: 24h / 72h / 1w / 30d
Owner: @<name>
Status: (Mitigating | Monitoring | Remediated)
Next step: <short bullet> (owner + ETA)
Blockers: <person> / <reason>
Related incidents (90d): <links>
Board card: <link>
```

lee: +1. add a single-line "recurrence score" so humans & automation can decide: recurrence_score = count(related incidents in 90d). if > 2 then escalate to patterns board.

tanya: metrics to track during pilot: percent of postmortems missing assigned owner at 24h, percent of actions without ETA at 72h, median time to remediation, and number of recurrence escalations. can infra add these to ops dashboard?

diego: i'll mock the board change (we use Linear) and add a "Checkpoints" lane. policy: moving the postmortem card to Closed requires at least one 72h checkpoint entry with owner + ETA.

priya: about IC rotation: weekly rotation with buddy for the first handoffs. recommend a 5-min handoff card with 3 bullets: what changed, open mitigations, any pending rollbacks. add a short command `!handoff @newIC` that posts the mini-card and requires buddy ack.

oncall-bot: `!handoff @newIC` command noted (mock). will post: "IC handoff initiated by @oldIC -> @newIC. buddy ack required."

alex: pilot plan: run for 6 teams for 6 weeks. goals: reduce owner-drift, cut stale-action rate by 50%, and catch recurring patterns earlier. i'll write a short RFC with checklist and pilot metrics.

lee: one more ops note: include a weekly automated audit that lists postmortems with missing 72h entries so managers can nudge teams. small email digest or a dashboard tile.

tanya: when pilot passes, make the 72h checkpoint a postmortem closure requirement (enforced by board policy). also add the recurrence_score check to trigger patterns review.

diego: i'll create the Linear lane and a template issue for the checkpoint card. linking to RFC when alex posts it.

priya: i'll prototype the bot posting and reaction-to-audit plumbing. will also emit metrics: reminders_sent, checkpoints_filled, reactions_used.

alex: thanks all. action items: alex RFC + pilot plan, diego board lane, priya bot prototype, lee dashboard tile. I'll tag reviewers and aim to start pilot next sprint. :thumbsup:

priya: tiny UX ask: make the bot checklist compact on mobile (single message with short lines) so ICs can update from phone.

oncall-bot: saved to tracker (mock): RFC-1955001234-closure-gate created by alex.

alex: closing for now. will ping when RFC ready for review.
